messages:
Leah (People Ops): hi team — quick one: my baby was born last week and the hospital charged us at discharge. I enrolled the newborn yesterday but the hospital says the claim was billed under 'self-pay'. Can benefits retroactively cover and how do we get the bill reprocessed? :sob:
Sam (Benefits): congrats! 🎉 yes, carriers will usually accept retroactive enrollment back to the date of birth. steps: 1) confirm enrollment effective date (we can set it to DOB) 2) get hospital to resubmit claim with new member ID or 3) file a member claim with the carrier including newborn docs. i can help with the paperwork.
Leah (People Ops): thanks. what docs do they need from our side? discharge summary? birth cert? receipt?
Sam (Benefits): typically: - proof of birth (hospital birth record or certificate) - enrollment confirmation from us (we'll provide) - itemized hospital bill (UB-04 or EOB) - any claim reference # the hospital used. I'll paste a short email template you can forward to the hospital billing team.
Sam (Benefits): ```Hi [Billing Contact],
Our dependent (baby, DOB: 10/17/2025) has been enrolled retroactively on our group plan with member ID [NEW_ID]. Please resubmit the claim for admission on [admission date] using the attached enrollment confirmation and birth record. Claim reference: [HOSPITAL CLAIM #]. Please send confirmation when resubmitted.
Thanks,
[Parent Name]```
Leah (People Ops): perfect — hospital gave me Claim# HB-48291 and an itemized UB-04 pdf. attaching in DM. should I ask them to change guarantor too? they currently list guarantor as parent with SSN last4.
Jorge (Billing): yes ask them to resubmit with the newborn as the subscriber/dependent and include the group plan info. if they can't change guarantor they usually add the dependent record on the claim form. also request a copy of the original claim submission (for appeals if needed).
Asha (People Ops): @Leah once you DM the documents I can generate the enrollment confirmation letter and call the carrier's provider support line to request expedited reprocessing. carriers usually give ~30–60 day retro windows but some accept longer for newborns.
Leah (People Ops): sending now. curious — any chance they waive the self-pay balance while claim in process? hospital hinted at payment plan only.
Sam (Benefits): hospitals vary. you can ask for an administrative hold or reduced payment while they reprocess, but it's not guaranteed. include the expected enrollment effective date and ask for hold on collections until claim adjudicated. we can also escalate with carrier for quick adjudication if you need immediate hold.
hospital-billing-bot: System: Payment plan options updated for account HB-48291. Outstanding balance: $8,220. Next due: 11/15/2025.
Leah (People Ops): oof. ok doing the hold request now. thanks all — appreciate the fast help. will post back once carrier confirms EOB or hospital resubmits. :pray:
